messages:
jen: saw a weird pattern in mobile onboarding: intermittent 429s when users open the app after backgrounding. server quota graphs look normal.
marco: mobile SDK? any resume/reconnect logic that might spike requests?
jen: yes react-native client auto-resumes pending page fetches + does aggressive prefetch on reconnect. snippet: ```js
// react-native sample config
const client = new RedwoodMobileClient({
  maxInflight: 8,
  prefetchPagesOnReconnect: 3,
  resumePendingRequests: true
});
```
dev-mobile-bot: note: resumePendingRequests will replay queued fetches on network change. combined with prefetchPagesOnReconnect that can create a short burst > account QPS.
kim: interesting, desktop/web quickstart defaults already trended conservative; mobile got more aggressive for UX reasons. parity/mode mismatch again.
marco: short-term mitigation: change sample to set prefetchPagesOnReconnect: 0 and add a reconnect smoothing window (200ms leaky-bucket) before replaying requests.
jen: i'll patch the mobile quickstart and add a tiny helper `smoothReconnect()` in the repo. also adding a one-line note in troubleshooting: "mobile 429s after background/resume? disable prefetch on reconnect or increase smoothing window."
sdk-bot: opened issue #2025: "mobile-sdk: smooth reconnect/replay defaults to avoid bursty onboarding 429s"
ops-bot: ops tip: if a paying customer hits this in prod we can temporarily raise burst allowance, but prefer changing defaults.
kim: medium-term: unify semantics across SDKs: explicit `replayMode: 'immediate'|'smooth'|'disabled'` and default to 'smooth'. also emit `client.resume.replayed` metric and `client.inflight` so Console can surface resume spikes.
jen: will file a parity PR and a short support-runbook blurb for mobile.
marco: great, thanks. this should reduce mobile onboarding noise without sacrificing UX. :+1:
